Market today:
The mood is mixed for tech. While some strategists see a "buy the dip" opportunity in tech after recent selloffs, specific names like SAP and Intuit are slumping due to AI concerns and customer flight. Oil is also sliding.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down -54.55% and marked SELL; its leveraged nature amplifies this. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is also down significantly at -41.75%. SMH (-12.66%) and QQQI (-4.06%) are also on TRIM. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep an eye on the broader S&P 500's ability to clear its hurdles towards 8,000. Also, watch for follow-through on the "buy the dip" sentiment in tech, especially in chip names.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions, as drawdowns on margin hurt extra.
plays: Seriously consider reducing SOXL exposure given the -54.55% loss and its leveraged decay.
Monitor SPAL closely; its newness and leverage amplify the -41.75% loss.
If looking to add to tech, MRVL (scanner entry 234.4-232.12, stop 228.36) aligns with "buy the dip" sentiment for chips.
